description.zh:
查询节点类型
- all: 表示同时查询 dn 与 gms 节点
- gms: 表示只查询 gms 节点
- dn: 表示只查询 dn 节点
description.en:
The type of nodes to query. Valid values:
- all: queries both dn and gms nodes.
- gms: queries only gms nodes.
- dn: queries only dn nodes.

description.zh: 页码。取值为大于0且不超过integer数据类型的最大值，默认值为**1**。
description.en: The page number. The value must be a positive integer that does not exceed the maximum value of the integer data type. Default value: **1**.
The number of entries per page.
The region in which the instance resides.
The keyword for filtering query results.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun polardbx describe-polarx-data-nodes --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --page-number 1 --page-size 30 --node-type dn --search-key pc-bp1c5w4fx00002274 --region cn-hangzhou
